status: Proposal contract (A14, F-PANE-VECTORS, gate G-PANE). Pending review by the spec/ contracts owner.
units: widthDp and heightDp are the app window's available size: dp on Android (currentWindowAdaptiveInfo), points on iOS (the scene's container size). Never the device, never physical pixels.
function: (widthDp, heightDp, posture, hinge, textScaleBand, inputMode, task) -> (widthClass, heightClass, panes, navigation, arrangement, hingeBounds)

tags.matrix: Every width class x height class x task, no posture.
tags.compactHeight: Height compact caps panes at 2; a player keeps priority (1 pane, supporting panels as sheets).
tags.fontScale: Accessibility text band removes one pane, never below 1, navigation unchanged. Each names its default-band 'baseline' vector.
tags.inputMode: Touch, keyboard and pointer give the same layout. Vectors sharing a 'group' differ only by inputMode.
tags.posture: Has a posture or hinge input. Android only: the iOS port skips these by tag (and by the 'posture-' id prefix), per ADR-0025 §5.
tags.separatingHinge: A separating vertical hinge gives exactly 2 panes split at the hinge (before the font-scale rule).
tags.occludingHinge: occlusionType FULL / isOccluding: no content inside the hinge bounds.
tags.nonSeparatingFold: A fold that does not separate is not an arrangement input.
tags.tabletop: Half-opened with a horizontal hinge: player screens put the picture above the hinge and controls below.

vectors.note: Landscape phone (pixel_9 rotated, 923 x 411): list and detail fit, rail.
Landscape phone, player: player priority, one pane, supporting panels as sheets.
Wide but short window (1280 x 411): three would fit by width; height caps it at two.
Extra-large width, compact height, player: still one pane.
Medium width needs height at least medium for list/detail: one pane.
Compact width and compact height (small freeform window): one pane, rail per ADR-0025 §3 height row.
Two panes become one; rail stays.
Already one pane: never below one; bottom bar unchanged.
Player at compact height is already one: stays one.
A huge window does not exempt large text: two become one.
touch input: same layout as touch.
keyboard input: same layout as touch.

Fold inner (pixel_9_pro_fold inner, approx 852 x 883) flat with a separating vertical hinge: exactly two, split at the hinge, no controls in or beside the hinge.
Book posture (half-opened, vertical hinge), player: video on one side, angles and points on the other.
Medium width supporting layout is one pane by the table; a separating vertical hinge makes it exactly two.
Large width workspace would be three; a separating vertical hinge makes it exactly two.
Rule order: the hinge physically divides the window, so a separating vertical hinge gives exactly two even for a player at compact height (one side each; nothing in the hinge).
User story 204: unfolded phone at a large font scale falls back from two panes to one; still no controls in or beside the hinge.
Fold inner flat where the fold does not separate (isSeparating false): the hinge is not an input to arrangement; generic table.
Occluding vertical hinge (occlusionType FULL): split at the hinge, no content at all inside its bounds.
Occluding hinge at a large font scale: one pane, and still no content inside the hinge bounds (gutter).
Tabletop (half-opened, horizontal hinge), player: picture above the hinge, transport and marks below.
Tabletop arrangement is for player screens only; a list/detail screen keeps its columns and treats the hinge as a band without controls.
Tabletop player at a large font scale: one fewer pane (one), still no controls in the hinge band. Posture never starts or stops playback.
Fold inner with a separating hinge, touch input: same layout.
Fold inner with a separating hinge, keyboard input: same layout.
Fold inner with a separating hinge, pointer input: same layout.
